scripts.dev:web: dotenv -- node scripts/use-backend.ts --start "[web] pnpm --filter @tiny-chat/web run dev"
scripts.dev:tauri: dotenv -- node scripts/use-backend.ts --start "[tauri] pnpm --filter @tiny-chat/tauri run tauri dev"
scripts.dev:tauri:ios: dotenv -- node scripts/use-backend.ts --start --host "[tauri] pnpm --filter @tiny-chat/tauri run tauri ios dev --host"
scripts.dev:tauri:android: dotenv -- node scripts/use-backend.ts --start --host "[tauri] pnpm --filter @tiny-chat/tauri run tauri android dev --host"
scripts.open:tauri:ios: dotenv -- node scripts/use-backend.ts --host "[tauri] pnpm --filter @tiny-chat/tauri run tauri ios dev --host --open"
scripts.open:tauri:android: dotenv -- node scripts/use-backend.ts --host "[tauri] pnpm --filter @tiny-chat/tauri run tauri android dev --host --open"

scripts.build:tauri:android: dotenv -- pnpm --filter @tiny-chat/tauri run tauri android build
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:frontend && pnpm lint:backend && pnpm lint:shared && pnpm lint:tauri
scripts.check: pnpm check:frontend && pnpm check:backend && pnpm check:shared && pnpm check:tauri && pnpm check:web
scripts.test: pnpm test:frontend && pnpm test:backend && pnpm test:shared && pnpm test:tauri
